cookies.head.meta-content1: Cookies, local storage, and privacy choices on openwalkietalkie.org.
cookies.content.p1: The site loads Google Tag Manager after you accept in Cookie settings. Google processes the container request. Enabled tags can collect page views, referrers, device and browser information, and approximate location inferred from IP addresses, and may set cookies. See Google’s Privacy Policy for details.
cookies.content.li1: Day/night theme: owt-theme in local storage remembers the theme you select. It stays on this browser until you clear it. If no choice is saved, we use your operating system's preference.
cookies.content.li2: Cookie choice: Select “Accept” or “Reject” in the cookie choice dialog. Your choice is saved in localStorage under owt-cookie-consent-v1 with no time-based expiry. You can change it from “Cookie settings” in the footer.
cookies.content.p2: These preferences are not sent to the waitlist API. Local storage is similar to cookies in that it saves information on your device, but it is not automatically attached to requests.
cookies.content.p3: Cloudflare hosts and protects the website and may set cookies when security features or challenges are used. Which cookies appear and how long they last depend on those features. Read Cloudflare's cookie descriptions for details.
cookies.content.p4: You can remove this site's cookies and local storage using your browser's site-data settings. Clearing storage resets the theme and shows the cookie choice dialog again. Blocking security cookies may prevent a Cloudflare security challenge from completing.
cookies.content.p5: Open the cookie choice dialog. You can read this page with JavaScript disabled.
cookies.content.p6: Your email is stored securely on the server when you submit the waitlist form. Clearing browser storage does not remove a signup. To leave the list, email privacy@cohdl.ai. See the Privacy Policy for collection, retention, and other requests.
